name: benchmark-compare
description: /bench runs your benchmarks before and after a change and compares the numbers.

regressionPercent.title: Regression threshold (%)
regressionPercent.description: A benchmark slower (or faster) than its baseline by more than this counts; within it is noise.

command.title: Benchmark command
command.description: The command /bench runs when none is given; empty to detect it from the project.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one run may take before it is stopped (at most 600).
